title: Panel Panic! A Panel de Pon clone
author: RogueStargun
selftext:
Remade this classic game which now runs in the browser via Webassembly.  
Written in Macroquad/Rust with a very much WIP online multiplayer mode I'd like to test with other folks.

comments.author: DeProgrammer99
comments.body: Smooth, looks nice, plays somewhat nicely like the original (e.g., I believe I managed to swap falling blocks to continue a chain and swapped one block under a falling one to complete another chain before the block I swapped out from under started falling), very glitchy cursor movement (both as the stack rises and sometimes randomly moving too far), definitely insufficient pauses, not perfectly placed pauses (managed to lose a fractional second after completing a chain), and it ended on a black screen after several stages. Keep at it. I tried making my own clone for a while ~20 years ago but couldn't get the gameplay *just* right and quit. I also tried to make an NES version ("TANES") ~11 years ago but couldn't figure out how to work around color limitations and rendering performance and quit, haha.

replies.author: RogueStargun
replies.body: Can you explain why the cursor movement is glitch? How did you end up on a black screen? What game mode was that?

replies.author: DeProgrammer99
replies.body: Did you not try to play it at all yourself? The tile-swapping cursor moves down and then back up in a split second each time the stack pushes up a new row. And it often goes farther than it should have if you move quickly--maybe because of having two or three buttons pressed at once, it's possibly detecting multiple presses of the arrow that I have *held*. I think the black screen was around round 8 of the adventure mode...

replies.author: RogueStargun
replies.body: I'm not seeing this on my end. What machine are you running?

replies.author: DeProgrammer99
replies.body: Chrome 145.0.7632.109, Windows 10. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k-gdi-G5-GU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k-gdi-G5-GU) I stopped recording right after one of the times that the cursor moved too far.

replies.author: RogueStargun
replies.body: I see, you're triggering the force scroll, and the cursor is lagging when you hit the force scroll. I think that's OK as long as the cursor doesn't shift too far. Force scroll speed is,a bit too high now. I'll tweak it down
